events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track to blast out loud?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Impact
angles.copy: An album that changed the game. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped today in '65, showcasing a new depth and sound. Still sounds fresh, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980, he would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's message of peace and love resonates as strongly as ever. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Timeless Artistry
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Elvis Presley's impact on music and pop culture is truly legendary. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind continues to inspire generations of guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock icon Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young Rod
angles.copy: Still rockin' at 82! Happy birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart, whose distinctive voice has given us countless anthems.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! His energy and wit are still pure gold.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's Smooth Vocals
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation of pop hits. Which one always gets you singing along?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and cultural icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Charm
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend whose talent and spirit shine brighter than ever.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Hit-Making Years
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo success, he's penned some of the biggest hits in UK music.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Feel-Good Vibes
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our playlists! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. His tunes still bring the sunshine.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Who's In Your Hall of Fame?
angles.copy: On this day in '89, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its first legends. If you could induct one artist right now, who would it be and why?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to enduring pop star, he's still got that magic touch.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Revolution
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. A moment that cemented their legend forever. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil's Iconic Sound
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! His distinctive voice and drumming have given us so many unforgettable hits.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Grant's Endearing Roles
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to more recent darker roles, he always captivates.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Enduring Pop Reign
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to solo icon, he truly brought SexyBack.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Legendary David Jason
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television, whose characters are etched in our hearts.

events.title: The Day The Music Died tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly (would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (would have been 97) tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering Music's Lost Stars
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, the music world lost three bright stars on 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s smash hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up 61
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still charming audiences and never gonna give up on those iconic tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Marley's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: The legend would have been 82 today. Bob Marley's music and message of unity continue to inspire millions worldwide. One Love.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King's Songbook
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songwriting genius has shaped the soundtrack of generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012, she would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and powerful performances continue to move us.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: That Heartbreak Moment
angles.copy: Remember where you were? Twenty-one years ago today, Take That announced their split, leaving a generation in tears. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine for Ali
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40! His reggae-pop classics are still essential listening.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed's Chart-Topping Journey
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From acoustic gigs to stadium tours, his songwriting magic continues to captivate.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle,' George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George's Spiritual Legacy
angles.copy: The 'Quiet Beatle' would have been 84 today. George Harrison's profound songwriting and spiritual journey left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who's iconic frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Daltrey's Timeless Roar
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still delivering that legendary rock 'n' roll energy.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British pop and new wave singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw's 80s Magic
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to Nik Kershaw! His intelligent pop hits defined the 80s for so many of us.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Coldplay's Golden Voice
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Chris Martin! Half a century of life, and countless anthems with Coldplay. What's your favourite lyric he's penned?

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman and rock icon Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Livin' On A Prayer at 65
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Still rocking stages and hearts worldwide.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Remembering singer-songwriter Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea's Timeless Sound
angles.copy: The distinctive voice of Chris Rea would have been 76 today. His soulful blues-rock continues to resonate.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Remembering The Supremes co-founder and Motown legend Mary Wilson, who would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Icon Mary Wilson
angles.copy: The incredible Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have been 83 today. Her legacy as a Motown pioneer lives on.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk debut
events.blurb: Michael Jackson famously introduced the iconic Moonwalk for the very first time during his performance at Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever on this day in 1983.

angles.name: The Day The Moonwalk Landed
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago today, Michael Jackson debuted the Moonwalk and changed dance forever. An iconic moment in music history!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Numan's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to Gary Numan! The electronic music pioneer whose unique sound continues to inspire. Are 'Friends' Electric?
